title: Pickup quote — observed QA calibration
build: Synthetic seeded and fixed reference; fixture SHA-256 c420375941097f3f66d26c73f161c77ec3b12e63cb847f0d07166e0678367359

viewports: 390x844 narrow viewport; not a physical phone

scope: Original synthetic fixture, not client work. Twelve logical cases × two viewport sizes × two reference builds = 48 retained execution rows: seeded build 20 pass / 4 fail; fixed build 24 pass. The four failed rows represent two deliberately seeded defect types, each reproduced at both widths. An AI operator executed the checks in the browser. This demonstrates calibration and reporting; it does not establish blind discovery of unknown production defects.
limitations: Synthetic demonstration only; no customer, purchase or revenue.
One installed desktop Chrome and two viewport sizes; no physical phone or cross-browser coverage.
Known defects were specified before testing; passing checks do not prove defect-free production software.
No backend, authentication, real booking, real payment, security audit, accessibility certification, load or complete business-rule coverage.
Screenshots show fictional Sample Tester/example.com inputs. All actual observations are preserved in observations.json.
Earlier exploratory runs were superseded by these 48 final-file observations and are not counted twice.
